enrollment_evidence_quote: Please review and sign enrollment services agreement via DocuSign.
phase_activation_evidence: Phase 1 is activation, that's month 1 through 3 when the program begins.
phase_traction_evidence: Traction is 4 through 9, that's typically when you start to see the credit score rebound.
phase_momentum_evidence: Phase 3 is Momentum, 10 through 60, that's the heart of the program where it all comes together.
phase_graduation_evidence: And then graduation is 60 months, clean slate.
credit_impact_evidence: In the beginning, you have a temporary dip to your score.
adjustment_period_evidence: There's an adjustment period at the start, that's normal.
